title: Expert Treasure-hunter
description: Add the following to your Roguish Skills. See the Rogue Starting Move, **Tricks of the Trade**.

submoves.title: Nose for Treasure
submoves.description: When you **Unearth Secrets**, no matter the outcome of the roll, you may also ask, Are there valuables here I don't know about? If yes, gain **adv** on the next roll to pursue them.

title: Better Lucky Than Good
description: When you take this Move you get Luck equal to your cha. When you **Defy Danger** or **Trade Blows**, on a 7-9, you can mark Luck instead of the other options.

outcomes.text: When you **Enjoy Downtime**, you can spend 1 Treasure helping an NPC(s) to regain Luck equal to your cha.

title: Breaking & Entering
description: When you make a plan to steal something, name the thing and ask the GM questions equal to your int. You and your allies get **adv** the first time they act following the plan.

title: Quick on the Draw
description: When the GM or another Player is about to make a Move, with their permission (out of character) you can mark a Condition to interrupt it and act immediately instead.

title: Vanishing Act
description: When you **are sure no one is paying attention directly to you**, you can disappear from a Scene entirely, not rejoining the narrative until the Scene ends. If you're in trouble or a bind, ask the GM what you must do to disappear and they will tell you (4 - int) of the following requirements:

bullets: When you reappear, it will come with trouble
You must leave something significant behind
You must mark a Condition in the process
